{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Youmay|the warship formation|[[Carth Onasi]], who went by the nickname of "Fleet", or the [[Star Wars: Armada|''Star Wars'': Armada]] miniature game}}
[[File:Imperial_Fleet_at_Endor_FFG.png|thumb|right|350px|Part of the Imperial fleet at Endor.]]
{{Quote|Alert all commands. Deploy the fleet.|Admiral [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
A '''fleet''' referred to a group of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] operating in conjunction with each other. Usually they organized into formations for better coordination during battle and training exercises.

Fleets were used for attack, [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]], or escort purposes. A fleet commonly used three or more [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]-class [[Starship/Legends|ships]], as well as varying classes of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].

Normally, the largest [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] were in the middle of the fleet, followed by smaller capital ships, then cruisers and [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], and at the edges of the fleet were positioned the smallest [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] and [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]]. Fightercraft took up positions throughout the fleet.
